notes.title: Big co-op update!
notes.notes:
🌟 What's New:

[list]
[*] Play the entire demo with a friend through shared-screen co-op
[*] Supports both local co-op and Steam Remote Play
[*] Full single-player experience remains available
[*] Jump in and out of co-op seamlessly
[/list]

Whether you're playing solo or teaming up with a friend, the choice is yours! The entire demo can now be experienced either way.

Boot up the game now and try out the new co-op mode - we can't wait to hear what you think!
Happy gaming!
